title: MACSEC: Address Coverity issue
description: Address a Coverity issue by moving assignment of ckn_table.  Add check to invalid SAK checking.

notes.body: I think your logic iterating trough both PSK and MKA tables using total_length as a safeguard is somewhat fragile. At least coverity is not happy about it. I would recommend separating the counts from the logic whether or not to use either table.
Can you post the coverity result?
